decisive_items: a large, heterogeneously attenuating right renal mass
heterogeneously enhancing expansile mass in the upper pole of the right kidney
tumoral extension into the right renal vein and inferior vena cava
response.rationale: Imaging shows a large enhancing renal mass with vascular invasion and pulmonary nodules, classic for renal cell carcinoma; other candidates lack key features or contradict age/imaging.

rejected.why: Imaging explicitly shows no nephrolithiasis, excluding this diagnosis.
Enhancement pattern atypical for angiomyolipoma and no fat component described.
Nephroblastoma is unlikely in a 27-year-old adult; age is a strong contradiction.
